source:
A long slender staff, made of ancient dragon-bone, with runes emblazoned all over its surface in bright silver.
It hums faintly, as if great power is locked within, yet alone it seems incomplete.
target:
一根又细又长的法杖，由远古龙骨制成，它通体铭刻着亮银色的符文。
它会发出微弱的嗡嗡声，仿佛有一股强大的力量被锁在其中，但单独一件时似乎并不完整。

source:
Assault nearby foes with 4 fast attacks for %d%% (at 0 Hate) to %d%% (at 100+ Hate) damage each. Stalked prey are always targeted if nearby.
		At level 3 the intensity of your assault overwhelms anyone who is struck, reducing their Defense by %d for 4 turns.
		The damage multiplier and Defense reduction increase with your Strength.

		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.
target:
对附近目标发动 4 次快速攻击，每次造成 %d%%（0 仇恨值时）至 %d%%（100+ 仇恨值时）伤害。若附近有被追踪的猎物，则总是攻击它。
		等级 3 时，猛烈攻击会压倒每个被命中的目标，使其闪避降低 %d，持续 4 回合。
		伤害倍率和闪避减值受力量值加成。

		如果你装备了盾牌，这一技能也会用你的盾牌攻击。

source:
You focus your senses, getting information from moments in the future.
		Improves your capacity to see invisible foes by +%d, to see through stealth by +%d, and to perform a critical spell cast by +%d%%.
		The effects will improve with your Spellpower.
target:
你集中感官，从未来的片刻中获取信息。
		侦测隐形等级提高 +%d，侦测潜行等级提高 +%d，法术暴击几率提高 +%d%%。
		此效果受法术强度加成。

source: Willpower defines your character's ability to concentrate. It increases your mana, stamina and PSI capacity, and your chance to resist mental attacks.
target: 意志属性决定你的角色集中精神的能力。它会提高你的法力值、体力值与灵能值上限，并提高精神豁免。

source:
Enhances your feeding by reducing your targeted foe's resistances, multiplying them by %0.2f and increasing your resistances by the amount drained. Resistance to "all" is not affected.
		Improves with your Mindpower.
target:
提高你的吸食能力，将目标的伤害抗性降低到原来的 %0.2f 倍，并将你自身相应的伤害抗性提高相同数值。对“所有”抗性无效。
		效果受精神强度加成。

source: Physical talents of the various horrors of the world.
target: 世界上各种恐魔的物理能力。

source: My old master-- who, though a powerful enchanter, did not compare to you and your glory-- saw fit to imprison me in this fine staff to aid him in his work. Alas, he is long gone, but I despair not, for I have found a mighty new master.
target: 我的前任主人——虽然也是一位强大的附魔师，但与您和您的无上荣光相比根本不值一提——决定将我囚禁在这根精良的法杖中以协助他的工作。唉，他早已不在人世，但我毫不绝望，因为我找到了一位强大的新主人。

deep_observation: 源文说“All enemies walking over the glyph”，译文写成“所有经过的目标”，丢了“敌人”这个限定。engine@624a673 game/modules/tome/data/talents/celestial/other.lua 中，陷阱的 canTrigger 只在 who:reactionToward(self.summoner) < 0 时触发，所以友方踩上去不会减速。译文读起来像是对任何单位都生效，与实现不符。
source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be slowed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
surface_observation: 原文限定为经过圣印的「enemies」，译文写成「目标」，遗漏了敌方限定。
target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的目标会减速 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。

source: You cannot increase this stat further until next level!
target: 在升级之前，你无法再次提升这项属性！

source: Rescued the merchant from the assassin lord.
target: 从刺客领主手中救回商人。

source:
Demonic taint. Yes I have a way to help in the archives. However this is a long process, the subject will need to live here for a while.
She will have to spend 8 hours per day in the regeneration tank.
target:
恶魔污染。是的，我有办法在档案区帮她。不过这个过程很漫长，她需要在这里住上一段时间。
她每天必须在再生槽中待上 8 小时。

deep_observation: “Dark visions fill your mind”指黑暗的幻象充满你的脑海。译文“无尽的黑暗扑面而来”丢了“幻象”和“脑海”，又凭空加了“无尽”，把心灵感应改成了外部的黑暗袭来，属于语义偏移。
source: Dark visions fill your mind as you lift the orb. It is cold to the touch.
surface_observation: 原文是黑暗幻象充满脑海，译文写成「无尽的黑暗扑面而来」，遗漏了幻象与脑海，并增添「无尽」。
target: 当你拿起这个水晶球时，无尽的黑暗扑面而来。这个球摸上去冰凉。

surface_observation: 成就名「Size matters」中的 size 被译为「伤害」，冻结输入没有支持这一含义的语境。

source: Enhances your Deadly Poison with an insidious agent, causing it to reduce the healing taken by enemies by %d%%.
target: 以阴险成分强化你的致命毒素，中毒目标受到的治疗效果减少 %d%%。

source: You talked to the Elder in Last Hope who in turn told you to talk to Tannen, who lives in the north of the city.
target: 你和最后的希望的长者交谈，得知要去找城市北边的泰恩。

deep_observation: “Corruptions”在这里指堕落系技能/法术，不是指人。engine@624a673 class/Actor.lua:5580/5600 在 bloodcasting 属性存在时，调整技能消耗活力的倍率（sanguisuge.lua:58 授予该属性），说明是施放堕落技能时改为消耗生命。译文“堕落者消耗生命值”把主语误译成施法者这类人，应改为“堕落技能/法术消耗生命值而非活力值”。
source: Corruptions consume health instead of vim.
surface_observation: source 的 Corruptions 指堕落系能力，target 译为“堕落者”，把能力误作使用者。
target: 堕落者消耗生命值来取代活力值。

source: Saps 30%% of the target's speed (increasing yours by the same amount) and inflicts %0.2f temporal damage for three turns.
surface_observation: source 以换行和两个制表符结尾，target 将这段格式字符全部删去。
target: 降低目标 30%% 速度，增加你等量的速度，并在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。

deep_observation: “taps the trapped soul”是汲取被困灵魂的力量，“xmanifesting %s”是显现/施展所得技能。engine@624a673 world-artifacts.lua:3620-3645 中，武器击杀后吞噬灵魂并获得 use_talent，之后可以反复充能、反复使用，灵魂并没有被释放。译文“放出了…被束缚的灵魂，模仿了%s”说成了释放灵魂、模仿技能，与机制不符。
surface_observation: source 的第一个 %s 位于“of”之后，target 将其移至 #SALMON# 标记之前；“manifesting %s”被译成“模仿了%s”，含义不符。
target: @Source@放出了%s#SALMON#被束缚的灵魂#LAST#，模仿了%s！

surface_observation: “Not yet sorry!”表示尚未后悔，target 的“还没呢，抱歉！”表达了道歉，含义相反。
source 末尾有空格，target 末尾没有；该条是 entity name 前缀，拼接后可能缺少分隔。
source 末尾有空格，target 末尾没有；该条是 entity name 前缀，拼接后可能缺少分隔。
source 的 savior 是“救世者／救主”，target 的“守护”改变了名称含义；冻结输入没有术语条目正文可供核对。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You need to find Berethh, the last person who may be able to help you.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你得找到贝里斯，也许他是最后一个可以帮助你的人。

deep_observation: 译文删了两个限定。一是“(if capable of marking)”：engine@624a673 archery.lua:64-77 中，只有在已学 Master Marksman 或存在 mark_steady 时才会判定标记，first_blood 的 +50 才会生效；译文“标记概率增加 50%”读起来像无条件加成。二是体力回复的“on hit”：archery.lua:87 的 incStamina 位于 archery_onhit 内，只在命中时回复；译文“回复 %0.1f 体力”丢了“命中时”。另外“Against these targets”只在前半句有所体现。
source:
You take advantage of unwary foes (those at or above 90%% life). Against these targets, Shoot, Steady Shot and Headshot bleed targets for %d%% additional damage over 5 turns and have a 50%% increased chance to mark (if capable of marking).
In addition, your Steady Shot, Shoot and Headshot now restore %0.1f stamina on hit.
surface_observation: source 限定 Steady Shot、Shoot 和 Headshot“命中时”回复体力，target 省略了“命中时”的条件。
target:
你趁敌人尚未防备（90%% 血量以上）施展攻击，射击、稳固射击和爆头使敌人流血 5 回合造成额外 %d%% 伤害，标记概率增加 50%%。
此外，你的射击、稳固射击和爆头回复 %0.1f 体力。

source:
#GOLD#Damage shields#LAST#
Various talents, items and powers can grant you a temporary damage shield.
Each works in a distinct manner, but will usually intercept a certain amount of damage that would otherwise hit you before crumbling.
target:
#GOLD#伤害护盾#LAST#
不同的技能、物品和力量可以在有限时间内提供一个伤害护盾，为你吸收部分伤害。
不同的护盾效果不同，但是一般来说，它们会吸收一定量本来会击中你的伤害，然后破碎。
战斗中使用的策略技巧。

surface_observation: 原文“aegis ”末尾有空格，译文“庇护的”缺少对应空格，可能影响与后续文本拼接的格式。

source: You do not have enough fortress energy to use %s.
target: 你的堡垒能量不足，无法使用%s。

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master; you have the rod. I am created to speak to the master.
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人；你有那根棒。我被创造出来，就是为了与主人交谈。

source:
Surround yourself with a forcefield, reducing all incoming damage by %d%%.
		Such a shield is very expensive to maintain, draining 5%% of your maximum psi per turn initially plus an addition 5%% for each turn it has been maintained. For example, on turn 2 it will drain 10%%.
		Current drain rate: %0.1f psi/turn
target:
用力场环绕自己，减少受到的所有伤害 %d%%
		维持这样的护盾代价非常昂贵：初始每回合消耗你 5%% 的最大灵能值，此后每多维持一回合再额外增加 5%%。例如第 2 回合会消耗 10%%。
		目前的灵能值消耗：每回合 %0.1f 灵能值

source: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to blind you with its murky ink.
target: 它向你伸出触手，试图喷射黑色的墨汁，使你失明。

source: Anmalice focuses its mind-piercing eye on #Target#!
target: 扭曲之刃·圣灵之眼将它穿透灵魂的目光集中在了 #Target# 上！

source: Was teleported into Caldizar's Fortress, far into the void between the stars.
target: 传送进凯尔帝勒的堡垒，群星中的虚空地带。

source:
Rushes forward and attempts to take the target to the ground, making a melee attack for %d%% damage then attempting to grapple them. If you're already grappling the target you'll instead slam them into the ground creating a radius 5 shockwave for %d physical damage and breaking your grapple.
		The grapple effects and duration will be based off your grapple talent, if you have it, and the damage will scale with your Physical Power.
target:
冲向目标，试图将其扑倒在地，进行一次近战攻击造成 %d%% 伤害，然后尝试抓取。如果已在抓取状态，则将目标猛砸向地面，制造冲击波，在半径 5 的范围内造成 %d 物理伤害并解除抓取。
		抓取效果和持续时间取决于你的抓取技能（若已习得），伤害受物理强度加成。

deep_observation: “he made the Sun from his breath”是他用自己的气息造出了太阳，译文“他深呼吸后把太阳高举”误成了先深吸一口气再举起太阳，丢了“创造太阳”这一神话要素。“All that this light touches shall be mine”是光所照之处皆归我有，译文“阳光所至，即我所至”改变了意思。“his might surpassed all else”译成“他的勇武震慑了众人”也有偏移。术语 petty gods→伪神与冻结条目一致。
source: #{italic}#'But AMAKTHEL came, and his might surpassed all else, and the petty gods fled before his glory. And he made the Sun from his breath and held it above the world and said, "All that this light touches shall be mine, and this light shall touch all the world.'#{normal}#
surface_observation: 原文说伪神逃离、阿马克泰尔以气息创造太阳；译文写成伪神慑服、他深呼吸后举起太阳，改变了两处明确动作。
target: #{italic}#但阿马克泰尔来了，他的勇武震慑了众人，伪神们慑服于他的荣耀。他深呼吸后把太阳高举到了世界之上，说：“阳光所至，即我所至，这光芒将照亮全世界。”#{normal}#

source: Improve your predation by learning from past hunts. You gain %0.2f accuracy and %0.2f armor penetration against foes for each foe of that type you have previously slain, to a maximum of %d accuracy and %d apr.
target: 你从过去的杀戮中汲取知识，强化你猎杀的能力。你过去每杀死过该类型的一个生物，就获得 %0.2f 命中和 %0.2f 护甲穿透，最多 %d 命中和 %d 护甲穿透。

source: The target's light, darkness, and fire resistance has been increased by %d%%.
target: 目标的光系、暗影和火焰伤害抗性增加 %d%%。

source: This mass of fused molten bone from the Heavy Sentinel radiates intense power. It still glows red with the heat of the Sentinel's core, and yet seems to do you no harm.
target: 这团来自重型哨兵的融合熔融骨骼散发着强大的力量。它仍因哨兵核心的热量而发红发亮，不过似乎不会伤害到你。

source: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
target: 这块表面缠绕着厚实藤蔓的沃瑞钽盾牌，许多年前由半身人将军阿尔曼达·鲁伊尔注入了自然之力。在烈火战争最激烈的时期，他用它抵挡兽人堕落者的魔法与疾病。

source: Give me an hour or so to make with the alchemy. Don't go anywhere.
target: 别走开，给我一个小时的时间去做药剂。

source: The Spellblaze Chronicles(2): A Night to Remember
target: 魔法大爆炸纪事(2)：难忘之夜

deep_observation: 第二段“Only a matter of time until that nobleman catches wind and comes after us”是担心贵族迟早听到风声来追杀，译文“本来只要再等一些时间，让那位贵族听到风声之后过来找我们，就可以…榨取一大笔钱”把威胁改写成了勒索计划的一部分，与后文加三倍守卫、不能走漏消息、寻找新藏身地的逻辑矛盾。第三段“leave that idiot burnt on a stake”是把他绑在柱上烧死，译文“穿在柱子上”是刺穿，与第四段的火刑意象不一致。
source:
The best haul we ever got, gone. We could have been set for life, the most legendary outlaws in all the lands! Villages would tremble at the thought of us roaming the woods.

Only a matter of time until that nobleman catches wind and comes after us. We were about to get more gold than we could count for his lassie back, and that dirt farmer set her on fire. Of all the skullbrained things to do for fun!

Ordered my men to kill any who pass by and been running triple guard. We need all the time we can get before they come for us, can't let any word out. Once we find somewhere new, I'll leave that idiot burnt on a stake as tribute and hope we don't catch chase. 

I'm going to enjoy hearing his screams, a log on the pyre a gold he cost us. Nice and slow, need to make sure he doesn't die easy.
surface_observation: 原文说贵族迟早会得知此事并追捕他们；译文写成等待贵族得知消息并前来，好从其女儿身上取得赎金，颠倒了这一句的处境与意图。
target:
我们费了九牛二虎之力才钓到大鱼，没了！我们本来可以因此扬名立万，成为被整个大陆传颂的不法之徒的传奇，我们的传说会在绿林中传颂，村庄会在我们的面前颤抖，现在全完了！

我们本来只要再等一些时间，让那位贵族听到风声之后过来找我们，就可以从那位大小姐身上榨取一大笔钱，结果那个土老帽村炮居然把她烧死了！这个傻逼还说是为了找乐子！

很好，叫我的人杀掉任何胆敢闯进来的人，守卫的密度增加三倍。我们需要尽可能在他们过来之前抓紧时间，绝对不能泄露任何消息。在我们找到新的藏身地之后，我要把那个蠢货穿在柱子上作为祭品，希望我们不会被他们抓到。

我要好好品尝他的哀嚎，他让我们每损失一枚金币，火堆上就多一根木柴。把这家伙文火慢烤，可别便宜他，让他死的太快了。

source: Pendant of the Sun and Moons

Magic has not disappeared from Maj'Eyal with the end of the Spellhunt.

During the Age of Dusk, as the Spellhunt was nearing its end, a powerful mage of the Kar'Krul, Linaniil, created a safe haven for the few remaining mages of all races.
This place is Angolwen, the City of Magic, and for over two thousands years has taught magic to preserve and expand it.

You have been told this story and can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Archmage class#WHITE#.

Archmagi are the pinnacle of spellcasters, attuned to the magical properties of the world.
Class features:#YELLOW#
- Cast elemental spells to burn your foes to death or freeze them
- Summon the powers of Space and Time to protect and cripple
- Dabble in Phantasms and Illusions
- Manipulate the forces of magic themselves#WHITE#

All mages use mana to cast their spells.
It slowly replenishes over time.
surface_observation: 原文两次明确写 Archmage／Archmagi，译文两次写“元素法师”，把职业名称换成了不同含义。
target:
魔法狩猎之后魔法并没有从马基·埃亚尔消失。

在黄昏纪元，当魔法狩猎接近尾声时，卡·克鲁尔的一名强大的法师——莱娜尼尔——为剩余的各种族的法师们建立了一个避风港。
这个地方就是安格利文，魔法之城，在这里，两千多年来一直传授魔法，以保存并发扬它。

现在，你已经知道了这个故事，你可以在创建人物时选择新的职业 #LIGHT_GREEN#元素法师#WHITE#。

元素法师是施法者中的顶峰，与世界的魔法属性相契合。
职业特点：#YELLOW#
- 施放元素法术将敌人烧死或冻结
- 召唤时空的力量保护自己并削弱敌人
- 涉猎幻术和幻象
- 操控魔法本身的力量#WHITE#

魔法师使用法力值来释放他们的法术。
法力值会随着时间缓慢恢复。

source: They asked about the staff and stole it from you.
target: 他们从你那里得知了法杖的消息，把法杖抢走了。
